Guides / Raids, Tower & events / Battle Tower

Battle Tower

A roguelike climb with one Pokémon: floors, paths, rewards, recruits and prizes.

FloorsRewards after each floorRecruitingEnd-of-run prize

The Tower opens with your 3rd badge. A climb starts with one Pokémon from your PC, turned back into the first stage of its line at Lv 5 (its look, IVs and nature stay). It gains EXP, learns moves and evolves as you climb. You catch wild ones mid-battle into a party of up to 6, starting with 3 Poké Balls. The run ends when the whole party is down.

  • Climb: your own Pokémon, endless, a best floor and a weekly board with friends.
  • Daily Tower: everyone gets the same loaned starter and the same floors, 50 floors, once a UTC day.
  • Auto-climb plays floors on its own and stops for rare looks and bosses if you like.

Floors

  • Floor level ≈ 3 + 0.95 × floor (Lv 100 by about floor 100); deeper floors also boost stats. Your Pokémon can level up to the next floor's level + 4.
  • Every 10th floor is a boss with HP bars (legendaries from floor 50); floors 20, 50, 80… are a Gym Leader of the biome.
  • Every 10 floors you pick the next biome (one of the islands).
  • Boss floors 50 / 100 / 150 drop a Golden Poké Ball: one more reward to pick from on every floor (up to 3).
PathWhat's there
RouteA wild Pokémon: beat it, or catch it for your party.
TrainerA trainer battle: more money and a better reward.
DenOne strong wild Pokémon, higher level, rare looks likelier (legendaries deeper in).
Rest StopNo battle: the party heals 60% and fainted ones get back up.
MartNo battle: pick a free reward, with better odds.
EventNo battle: something strange, and a choice with a price.

Rewards after each floor

Pick 1 of 3. Each slot rolls a tier: Common 75%, Great 19%, Ultra 4.7%, Rogue 1.2%, Master 0.1%, and Luck tries to push it up a step at a time. Reroll with run money (cost doubles each reroll).

Luck: Shiny 1, Void 2, Prismatic 3, Alpha +1 for each party member, +2 per Shiny Charm reward, up to 14. It also makes rare looks likelier on wild floors.

Wild floors roll Shiny 1 in 300, Void 1 in 1,800, Prismatic 1 in 6,000 and Gilded 1 in 12,000 at Luck 0 on a Route, all × (1 + Luck ÷ 4), and ×3 on Dens. The Tower and Raid Eggs are where Gilded Pokémon come from. A recruit keeps its look when it comes home.

Recruiting

Throw a run ball at a beaten wild Pokémon: Poké 50%, Great 70%, Ultra 88%, Master always; strong species are up to 25% harder (never below 15%). Bosses only to a Master Ball. At the end, one recruit comes home to your PC.
